when.quote: Ask for the replacement reason and record exactly one of: fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, or other.

info.about: Exactly one of fraud_suspected, lost, stolen, damaged, expired, other. Unrecognized charges with the card still in hand mean fraud_suspected.

steps.quote: The old card is automatically cancelled for security and will no longer work for new purchases.

jobs.done_when: order_replacement_credit_card_7291 has been called with the confirmed reason, the customer-confirmed shipping address, the chosen speed and any fee consent. The customer has been told the old card is cancelled, the delivery window, any fee and the email notifications, and has had the reminder to dispute unauthorized charges. Or, if the customer is not eligible, the reason and next steps have been explained.

documents.why: Internal procedure for ordering a replacement credit card: pre-checks, shipping fees by tier, the order_replacement_credit_card_7291 tool and its arguments, and what to tell the customer afterwards
Shipping options, delivery times and expedited fees by tier; recommends expedited shipping for fraud
Customer-facing account of what changes after a replacement: new number and CVV, same account number, email notifications
Eligibility: no pending replacement allowed; limits by tier per 60-day period
get_pending_replacement_orders_5765 tool for checking pending replacement orders
Review transaction history for suspicious activity; follow the stolen card protocol if any is found
Defines unauthorized charges as charges the customer didn't make or doesn't recognize
Dispute filing procedure (file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829, card_action cancel_and_reissue). Use only if the customer asks to dispute.

open_questions: No tool or record is documented for counting how many replacements were made in the past 60 days. The agent can check only for pending orders (get_pending_replacement_orders_5765) and any replacement data that get_credit_card_accounts_by_user returns.
The exact parameter names for order_replacement_credit_card_7291 are not given (the document says 'account_id or card_id'). The agent must use the schema the unlock returns.
No document gives a procedure for simply listing credit card transactions. The step rests on the policy's verification rules and on the get_credit_card_transactions_by_user tool.
It is unclear whether the agent should proactively file disputes after a fraud replacement. The document says only to remind the customer to dispute in the app or website, so file only on request.
